Ordering (section 10): Comparer<T>.Default, IComparable<T>, authored IComparer<T>, OrderBy/ThenBy, Min/Max/MinBy, List<T>.Sort with ranges and comparers, error wrapping, and tuple ordering over a nonconforming element. Probe forwards <Group><Case>: Ord, Sort, Tup. Expected values are .NET 10's (probes b6-parity and b6-extra), with OrderBy materialized by ToList() as section 10's eager queries are. NeoInvalidOperationError is InvalidOperationException and InnerError is InnerException. Fix round 1 groups: Em (empty Min, Max, MinBy, MaxBy and Average; probe b6-fix1-empty), Rl (relational operators on one enum type and lifted nulls; probe b6-fix1-relational), SortTx (the inconsistent-comparer text names Comparison`1 of the list's T; probe review-b6-sdk-sorttext), Srn (List<M?>.Sort() with null entries: CompareTo(null) calls and order) and Srd (explicit and base-type Comparer.Default in Sort and OrderBy), both with sizes 2 to 100 from probe review-b6-rt-ordering; Srn and Srd keep their own <Group>-prefixed classes and a <Group>Probe.
